summary_en: ¥6.0M upper limit, 1,000 shares (0.006% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥6,000/share implied ceiling, open-market acquisition from 17 June to 30 June 2026, to fund stock option (新株予約権) grants.
title_en: Notice of decision on matters concerning acquisition of treasury stock
translation_en_brief: The Bank of Saga announced on 16 June 2026 that its Board of Directors resolved to acquire up to 1,000 of its own ordinary shares for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥6.0 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 17 June and 30 June 2026. The stated purpose is to fund the issuance of shares upon exercise of stock options granted to employees. The 1,000-share limit represents 0.006% of shares outstanding excluding treasury (computed as 1,000 ÷ 16,901,764 ex-treasury shares as of 31 May 2026). The implied price ceiling is ¥6,000 per share.
